William Oduor  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6543 | william.oduor@nexacloud.com  

A junior full-stack developer with a focus on scalable SaaS solutions, leveraging Python, React, and cloud infrastructure to build reliable, high-performance systems. My work emphasizes automation, database optimization, and seamless integration between front-end and back-end components.  

**Projects**  
*CloudSync Dashboard (NexaCloud Solutions, 2023)*  
Designed a real-time data synchronization tool using Python’s FastAPI for backend services and React for interactive dashboards. Implemented load balancing with NGINX to handle 5,000+ concurrent connections, reducing latency by 30%. Integrated MongoDB with change streams to enable real-time analytics, improving data freshness by 40%.  

*InvoiceFlow API (InnovateTech Inc., 2022)*  
Developed a REST API for a B2B invoicing platform using Node.js, handling 10,000+ requests/day. Optimized PostgreSQL queries for complex financial reports, reducing average response time from 800ms to 200ms. Collaborated on CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, achieving 95% deployment reliability.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Junior Full-Stack Developer | NexaCloud Solutions (2023)*  
- Built microservices in Python for a SaaS platform, supporting 15+ client integrations via REST APIs.  
- Automated Docker containerization for 12 services, reducing deployment errors by 60%.  
- Configured Terraform for AWS infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 40% for new environments.  
- Monitored MongoDB performance, implementing sharding for a 200M document dataset to improve read speeds by 50%.  
- Deployed CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, achieving 98% deployment success rate across 10+ environments.  

*Software Developer Intern | InnovateTech Inc. (2022)*  
- Developed front-end components in React for a customer portal, increasing user engagement by 25% through interactive UI enhancements.  
- Collaborated on PostgreSQL schema design for a multi-tenant architecture, supporting 50+ client databases with minimal overhead.  
- Integrated AWS S3 for document storage, reducing server costs by 35% through optimized storage tiers.  
- Contributed to load testing with JMeter, identifying bottlenecks in API endpoints and improving throughput by 30%.
